title: Not able to unselect item in MultiRange
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Maybe both? May not be something considered before now or something that was missed out in testing.

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**
When an item in a `<MultiRange />` is selected it cannot be unselected by clicking the same item again.

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**
When I click on an already selected item in a `<MultiRange />`
Then that item should unselect and no longer be filtering results based on it

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**
From what I can tell this is not something which is browser based

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
To be able to unselect an active Range without having to select another range

This issue can be seen on the [React Storybook](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/storybook/?selectedKind=MultiRange\&selectedStory=default\&full=0\&down=1\&left=1\&panelRight=1\&downPanel=kadirahq%2Fstorybook-addon-knobs) for the MultiRange component.

You can select one of the items (such as <$10) but then cannot unselect it.

While this could be unselected using the `<CurrentRefinements />` widget, I believe it's better suited to also have it available in the `<MultiRange />` component also.

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
2.2.5
